overrides._comment: Load runs measure optimized builds. The conformance manifest starts debug or size-tuned builds for some bindings, so these entries replace only prepare and start.

rust-axum.prepare: adapters/rust/scripts/pack-assets.sh && CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR="$PWD/adapters/rust/target" cargo build --release --locked --target-dir adapters/rust/target --manifest-path adapters/rust/Cargo.toml -p rust-conformance

rust-axum-postgresql.prepare: adapters/rust/scripts/pack-assets.sh && CARGO_BUILD_BUILD_DIR="$PWD/adapters/rust/target" cargo build --release --locked --target-dir adapters/rust/target --manifest-path adapters/rust/Cargo.toml -p rust-conformance
